verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents reading account data from a linked bank (Data API) and verifying account ownership against the user's identity (Verification API). It also documents storing bank account details for future payment initiation and Direct Debit mandates, which together approximate verified, reusable funding credentials without manual verification. However, no evidence shows the API returning account and sort/routing numbers or a token explicitly for funding bank-debit payments, and ACH is not covered. missing for 10: explicit documentation that account/routing (sort code/IBAN) numbers or tokens are returned from a linked account, an explicit link from verified account data to Direct Debit funding, an explicit no-micro-deposit claim, US ACH coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can obtain verified account and routing numbers (or tokenized equivalents) from a linked account to fund ACH or bank-debit payments without micro-deposits

citations.quote: Access identity, accounts, transactions and balance data for all integrated banks with a single interface.
We compare the identity data to the account holder's name for all the connected account(s) the user has given consent for.
Store bank account details for future payment initiation. Covers setup, consent and reuse.
Payment mandates belong to one of three types: Sweeping VRPs... Wave 1 VRPs... Direct Debits
